title: Europe’s new China playbook – European Council on Foreign Relations
gist: ECFR podcast episode page: Mark Leonard and Andrew Small discuss Europe's shift toward a tougher China policy over Chinese overcapacity, including an October 9th Beijing deal on volume limits for hybrid vehicles.

insights.claim: At the June 2026 European Council leaders largely agreed that the surge of Chinese exports threatens European industry and tasked the Commission with one last attempt at a trade deal with Beijing.
insights.speaker: Mark Leonard, Andrew Small
insights.so_what: EU trade defence against China is hardening.
insights.locator: Over the summer, Europe's approach to China shifted

insights.claim: After talks in Beijing on October 9th, EU commissioner Maros Sefcovic announced China accepted volume limits on hybrid vehicles, described as the biggest problem for Europe's car industry.
insights.speaker: Mark Leonard, Andrew Small
insights.so_what: Supports European autos near term; watch implementation.

insights.claim: A leaked France-Germany paper set out a tougher EU China agenda days before the talks, and the episode asks what options Europe has against 'China shock 2.0' and the threat of European deindustrialisation.
insights.speaker: Mark Leonard, Andrew Small
insights.so_what: Franco-German alignment makes tougher measures more likely.
